series.title: Mee Myself and I
series.dek: Bowl-by-bowl field notes on Penang noodles — tasted, mapped, dated.
series.intro: A running field diary of Penang noodles: hawkers, kopi, and the occasional mid-afternoon hunger that requires moooore. I show up, order, photograph, and write what the bowl actually did. C-Mee-PO, my AI research assistant, briefs the history so we can enjoy both the taste and the cultural context.

series.title: Family Matters
series.dek: Weekends and evenings with kids — practical planning notes, not parenting advice.
